child: What it shows: usually a Text, an icon, or both.
semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls it when its visible text does not say, as for an icon alone.
enabled: False fades it and stops it taking presses and focus.
autofocus: Takes the keyboard's focus when it first appears.
focusNode: Its focus node, to move focus to it or follow it from outside; one is made when not given.
onChanged: Told each new value as it changes.
controller: Holds its state, to read and change from outside; one is made when not given.
placeholder: Faint text shown while it is empty.
inputFormatters: Rules for what can be typed, such as digits only.
keyboardType: The on-screen keyboard to show: numbers, an email address, a phone number.
textInputAction: What the on-screen keyboard's action key says and does: next, done, search.
autofillHints: What the platform may fill in here from saved details: an email, a password.
obscureText: Hides what is typed, as for a password.
maxLines: The most lines it grows to before scrolling.
minLines: The fewest lines it shows, even when empty.
onSubmitted: Told the text when the keyboard's action key is pressed.
readOnly: Shows its text, selectable, but takes no typing.
leading: Before the label: usually an icon.
trailing: After the label: usually an icon.
onPressed: Called when it is pressed. Null disables it.
error: Marks it as wrong, in the destructive colour. Inside a FormItem, a screen reader also hears that it is invalid.
axis: Horizontal lays it out across; vertical, down.
align: How it lines up along that side: at the start, the centre or the end.
side: Which side it opens on. It moves to the other side when there is no room.
options: What can be chosen, in order.
emptyText: Shown when nothing matches what was typed.
padding: Room around the content, inside the scrolling.
spacing: Space between its parts, in logical pixels.
onValuesChanged: Told the new values whenever one changes.
onRangeChanged: Told the new range whenever either end changes.
shortcut: A key combination, shown faint at the end: Text('⌘K').
initiallyOpen: Whether it starts open, when nothing holds its state from outside.
variant: How it looks; the values of its variant type say what each is for.
border: A line between it and the rest.
color: Its colour. Null takes the theme's.
ToggleGroupItem.value: The value it stands for, given back when it is pressed.
ToggleGroupItem.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls it, for an item that shows an icon alone.
ToggleGroupItem.enabled: False fades it and leaves it out of the group's choices.
DateNamesScope.child: The part of the app whose dates use these names.
DateNamesScope.names: Month and weekday names, and how a date is written.
MessageScrollerItem.child: The row: a message, a marker, a typing indicator.
HoverCard.child: What is hovered or focused to open it.
HoverCard.openDelay: How long the pointer rests before it opens.
HoverCard.closeDelay: How long it stays after the pointer leaves, so the pointer can reach it.
Bubble.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls it when it is a button and its text does not say.
Bubble.reactionsSide: Whether the reactions sit over the top edge or the bottom.
Kbd.child: The key's name or symbol: Text('⌘'), Text('Enter').
JoinedPosition.child: The control that takes its place in the group.
JoinedPosition.first: Whether it starts the group, which rounds its leading corners.
JoinedPosition.last: Whether it ends the group, which rounds its trailing corners.
CardImage.child: The picture: an Image, cropped to fill the width.
Tooltip.child: What it describes: hovered, focused or long pressed to show it.
Popover.builder: Builds what opens it, given a controller to open and close it with.
Popover.controller: Opens and closes it from outside; one is made when not given.
DropdownMenu.builder: Builds what opens it, given a controller to open and close it with.
DropdownMenu.items: The menu's rows: items, separators, labels, groups and submenus.
DropdownMenu.controller: Opens and closes it from outside; one is made when not given.
DropdownMenu.width: How wide the menu is; as wide as what opened it, at least, when not given.
Collapsible.builder: Builds what opens and closes it, given whether it is open and a way to toggle it.
Collapsible.child: What shows when it is open.
Collapsible.open: Whether it is open, when you hold its state.
Collapsible.onChanged: Told when it opens or closes.
Pressable.builder: Builds how it looks, given whether it is hovered, pressed, focused or disabled.
Pressable.autofocus: Takes the keyboard's focus when it first appears.
FormItem.builder: Builds the control from the field's state: its value, a way to change it, and whether it is wrong.
FormItem.label: Above the control, or beside it when across.
FormItem.description: Under the control: what the field is for.
FormText.label: Above the field.
FormText.description: Under the field: what it is for.
FormText.enabled: False fades it and leaves it out of the form's checks.
FormText.leading: Inside the field, before the text: usually an icon.
FormText.trailing: Inside the field, after the text: usually an icon or a button.
AshlarApp.builder: Wraps every page: for providers the whole app needs.
AshlarApp.initialRoute: The page to open on, by name, instead of home.
AshlarApp.onGenerateRoute: Makes a page for a name not in routes.
AshlarApp.navigatorKey: The navigator's key, to push pages from outside the widget tree.
AshlarApp.themeMode: Light, dark, or as the device is set.
AshlarApp.locale: The app's language and region, when not the device's.
AshlarApp.supportedLocales: The languages and regions the app is written for.
AshlarApp.title: The app's name, for the task switcher and the browser tab.
NavigationMenuLink.title: The link's name.
NavigationMenuLink.description: A line under the name: where it goes.
NavigationMenuItem.label: Its name in the bar.
NavigationMenuItem.content: What its panel shows, usually links; null makes it a link itself.
NavigationMenuItem.onPressed: Called when it is chosen, for an item without a panel.
QuestionChoice.label: What the answer says.
QuestionChoice.value: The answer's value, given back in the answers.
QuestionChoice.enabled: False fades it and stops it being picked.
Question.otherPlaceholder: Faint text in the answer field while it is empty.
CardHeader.title: The card's title.
CardHeader.action: At the end of the header: a button or a menu.
CardFooter.alignment: How the footer's children line up along it.
Card.children: Its parts, top to bottom: CardImage, CardHeader, CardContent, CardFooter.
Card.size: Small cards have less room inside.
Dialog.title: The dialog's title, read first by a screen reader.
Dialog.content: Its body, which scrolls when it is too tall.
Dialog.actions: Along the bottom, the main one last: usually buttons.
Dialog.showClose: A close button in the corner.
Radio.label: Beside the radio button.
Radio.value: The value it stands for, given back when it is chosen.
PopoverHeader.title: The panel's title.
AlertDialog.title: The question or warning.
AlertDialog.description: What happens next, in a line or two.
AlertDialog.destructive: Draws the action in the destructive colour, for what cannot be undone.
Alert.title: The alert's title.
Empty.title: What is empty.
Sheet.title: The sheet's title.
Drawer.title: The drawer's title.
Item.title: The item's name.
AccordionItem.title: The heading that opens and closes it.
AccordionItem.content: What shows when it is open.
Accordion.multiple: Several may be open at once, not one.
TabItem.label: The tab's name.
TabItem.content: What shows when the tab is chosen.
TabItem.enabled: False fades the tab and stops it being chosen.
Tabs.index: Which tab is chosen, when you hold its state.
Tabs.initialIndex: Which tab is chosen first, when nothing holds its state.
ComboboxOption.label: What the option says.
ComboboxOption.enabled: False fades it and stops it being picked.
ComboboxOption.keywords: Other words that find it when typed.
Combobox.values: The values chosen, for a combobox that takes several.
Combobox.searchPlaceholder: Faint text in the search field.
SelectOption.label: What the option says.
SelectOption.enabled: False fades it and stops it being chosen.
MenubarMenu.label: The menu's name in the bar.
Menubar.menus: The menus, in order along the bar.
CommandItem.label: What the item says.
CommandItem.enabled: False fades it and stops it being chosen.
CommandItem.leading: Before the label: usually an icon.
CommandGroup.heading: The group's heading.
Command.maxHeight: The tallest the list grows before it scrolls.
DataColumn.label: The column's heading.
DataColumn.flex: Its share of the width, against the other columns'.
DataColumn.numeric: Its values line up at the end, as numbers do.
DataTable.caption: Says what the table holds, above it and to a screen reader.
DataTable.footer: Under the last row: totals, a pager.
DataTable.sortAscending: Whether the sorted column runs low to high.
DataTable.onSelectChanged: Told the rows picked; with it, each row has a box to pick it.
DataTable.rowBuilder: Builds a row's cells, by its number.
DataTable.height: The table's height; it scrolls inside it.
BreadcrumbItem.label: The page's name.
BreadcrumbItem.onPressed: Goes to the page. Null for the page you are on.
Breadcrumb.items: The pages, from the top down to this one.
Toggle.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls it, for a toggle that shows an icon alone.
ToggleGroup.multiple: Several may be on at once, not one.
Button.size: Its height and room, or a square for an icon alone.
Avatar.image: The picture. The fallback shows until it loads, or when it fails.
Attachment.state: Where it is on its way: idle, uploading, processing, failed or done.
Spinner.size: Its width and height; the icon size around it when not given.
Spinner.color: Its colour; the text colour around it when not given.
Skeleton.circle: Round, for where an avatar will be.
Slider.value: The value, between min and max.
Slider.values: The values of a slider with several thumbs, in order.
Slider.onChangeEnd: Told the value when a drag or a key press ends: for saving.
DatePicker.range: The days picked, for a picker that takes a span.
DatePicker.firstDate: The earliest day that can be picked.
DatePicker.lastDate: The latest day that can be picked.
DatePicker.isDisabled: Days that cannot be picked: weekends, booked days.
Calendar.range: The days picked, for a calendar that takes a span.
Calendar.onDaysChanged: Told the days picked, for a calendar that takes several.
Calendar.autofocus: Takes the keyboard's focus when it first appears, on the picked day.
DateRange.end: The last day, or null while only the first is picked.
MenuSub.inset: Lines its label up with items that have a mark before them.
MenuSub.leading: Before the label: usually an icon.
InputOtp.length: How many characters the code has.
InputOtp.onCompleted: Told the code once every box is filled.
Carousel.controller: Moves it from outside, and tells which slide shows.
Carousel.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls it: 'Featured products'.
ScrollArea.itemCount: How many items there are, for a list built as it scrolls.
ScrollArea.itemBuilder: Builds an item, by its number.
ScrollArea.itemExtent: Each item's height, when they are all the same: faster to scroll.
ScrollArea.controller: Its scroll position, to read or move from outside.
Separator.axis: Horizontal draws a line across; vertical, down.
MessageScroller.controller: Moves it from outside, and tells what it shows.
MessageScroller.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls the conversation.
MessageScroller.start: Where it opens: the start, the end, or the last anchored turn.
MessageScroller.padding: Room around the rows, inside the scrolling.
Message.align: Which side it sits on: the other party at the start, you at the end.
BubbleGroup.children: The bubbles, in the order they were sent.
MessageGroup.children: The messages, in the order they were sent.
Marker.variant: Faint text, between two lines, or with a line under it.
Item.variant: How it is set apart: plainly, with a border, or on a muted fill.
ItemGroup.variant: How its items are set apart.
Alert.variant: Plain, or in the destructive colour for something wrong.
Badge.variant: Its fill: primary, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost or link.
Badge.leading: Before its text: usually an icon.
Button.variant: Its fill: primary for the main action, then secondary, outline, ghost, destructive or link.
Toggle.variant: Plain, or with a border all the time.
ToggleGroup.variant: Plain, or with borders all the time.
Tabs.variant: A pill on a muted track, or a line under the chosen tab.
Bubble.variant: Its fill: primary, secondary, muted, tinted, outline, ghost or destructive.
SidebarLayout.variant: Edge to edge, floating, or with the page inset as a card.
SidebarLayout.side: Which side of the screen it is on; it follows the reading direction.
SidebarLayout.header: Above the groups: the app's name, a team switcher, a search field.
SidebarLayout.footer: Below the groups: who is signed in.
SidebarLayout.collapse: How it gets out of the way: to icons, out of sight, or not at all.
SidebarLayout.onOpenChanged: Told when it opens or closes.
SidebarLayout.initiallyOpen: Whether it starts open, when nothing holds its state.
SidebarLayout.width: How wide it is when open.
SidebarItem.icon: Its icon, shown alone when the sidebar is collapsed.
SidebarGroup.action: A small button at the end of the group's label: add, more.
AttachmentAction.onPressed: Called when it is pressed. Null disables it.
Field.onPressed: Makes the whole card a target, pressing the control, for a field drawn as a card.
Field.axis: Vertical puts the label above; horizontal puts the control first and the label beside it.
FieldSet.legend: Its title, read before its fields.
Input.controller: Its text, to read and set from outside; one is made when not given.
Textarea.controller: Its text, to read and set from outside; one is made when not given.
Input.enabled: False fades it and stops it taking focus or typing.
Textarea.enabled: False fades it and stops it taking focus or typing.
Input.onChanged: Told the text as it changes.
Textarea.onChanged: Told the text as it changes.
TypographyTable.rows: The rows, each a list of cells.
QuestionnaireLabels.submit: The button on the last question.
QuestionnaireLabels.required: Shown when a required question is left unanswered.
Questionnaire.labels: The words on its buttons and in its messages.
Questionnaire.shortcuts: Letters or numbers that pick answers, shown beside them.
Questionnaire.showProgress: Where you are, as words and a bar, above the questions.
ChartTooltip.indicator: The mark beside each value: a dot, a line, a dashed line or none.
ChartSlice.icon: Shown in the legend and the tooltip in place of the colour swatch.
BarChart.labels: One per bar or group of bars: the months, say.
LineChart.labels: One per point: the months, say.
AreaChart.labels: One per point: the months, say.
BarChart.series: The values, a run per series.
LineChart.series: The values, a line per series.
AreaChart.series: The values, an area per series.
RadarChart.series: The values, a shape per series.
BarChart.legend: Where the legend sits, or none. Tapping a name hides its series.
LineChart.legend: Where the legend sits, or none. Tapping a name hides its series.
AreaChart.legend: Where the legend sits, or none. Tapping a name hides its series.
PieChart.legend: Where the legend sits, or none.
RadarChart.legend: Where the legend sits, or none. Tapping a name hides its series.
RadialChart.legend: Where the legend sits, or none.
BarChart.tooltip: How the tooltip looks, or that there is none.
LineChart.tooltip: How the tooltip looks, or that there is none.
AreaChart.tooltip: How the tooltip looks, or that there is none.
PieChart.tooltip: How the tooltip looks, or that there is none.
RadarChart.tooltip: How the tooltip looks, or that there is none.
RadialChart.tooltip: How the tooltip looks, or that there is none.
PieChart.slices: The slices, clockwise from the top.
RadialChart.slices: The values, a ring each from the outside in, or parts of one ring.
PieChart.inner: A second ring inside: the same whole split another way.
PieChart.donut: A hole in the middle, for the center widget.
PieChart.center: In the hole: the figure the chart is about.
PieChart.format: How a value is written in the tooltip and read out.
RadarChart.format: How a value is written in the tooltip and read out.
RadialChart.format: How a value is written in the tooltip and read out.
RadarChart.size: Its width and height, labels included.
RadialChart.size: Its width; a half ring is about half as tall.
RadarChart.grid: Polygons, circles, or nothing behind the shapes.
AshlarTheme.data: The theme for everything below it.
AshlarThemeData.colors: Every colour the components use, by role.
AshlarThemeData.brightness: Light or dark: what the colours were made for.
PopoverPanel.minWidth: The narrowest it is; as wide as what opened it, at least, when not given.
PopoverPanel.info: Where it opens: the rectangle of what opened it, and the room around.
Skeleton.child: What it stands in for: its size is the skeleton's when given.
_Cartesian.labels: One per bar, point or group: the months, say.
_Cartesian.series: The values, one run per series.
_Cartesian.legend: Where the legend sits, or none. Tapping a name hides its series.
_Cartesian.tooltip: How the tooltip looks, or that there is none.
AshlarColors.foreground: Text and icons on the page.
AshlarColors.cardForeground: Text and icons on a card.
AshlarColors.popoverForeground: Text and icons in a menu, popover or dialog.
AshlarColors.primaryForeground: Text and icons on the primary colour.
AshlarColors.secondaryForeground: Text and icons on the secondary colour.
AshlarColors.mutedForeground: Text that recedes: hints, descriptions, placeholders.
AshlarColors.accentForeground: Text and icons on the accent colour.
AshlarColors.destructiveForeground: Text and icons on the destructive colour.
AshlarColors.sidebarPrimary: The sidebar's chosen item and its mark.
AshlarColors.sidebarPrimaryForeground: Text and icons on the sidebar's primary colour.
AshlarColors.sidebarAccent: A hovered or chosen sidebar item's fill.
AshlarColors.sidebarAccentForeground: Text and icons on the sidebar's accent colour.
AshlarColors.sidebarBorder: Lines in and around the sidebar.
AshlarColors.sidebarRing: The focus ring inside the sidebar.
CommandItem.shortcut: A key combination, shown faint at the end: '⌘K'.
AvatarDot.color: Its colour: green, for online, unless you say.
ChartSlice.color: Null takes the theme's chart colours in turn.
ChartSeries.label: The series' name, in the legend, the tooltip and what a screen reader hears.
ChartSlice.label: The slice's name, in the legend, the tooltip and what a screen reader hears.
ChartSlice.value: Its size; its share is this over the total.
PieChart.labels: Writing on the slices: none, each value inside, or each name outside.
Sheet.content: Its body, which scrolls when it is too tall.
Drawer.content: Its body, which scrolls when it is too tall.
Item.size: Medium, small or extra small: how much room it has.
Switch.size: Medium, or small to sit in a dense row.
Field.label: Names the control: above it, or beside it when across.
Field.description: Under the control: what it is for.
SidebarItem.label: Its name; shown in a tooltip when the sidebar is collapsed to icons.
SidebarGroup.label: The group's title.
AshlarSelectionMenu.items: The menu's buttons: cut, copy, paste, select all.
